bio.text: Dennis Hannon is the Republican and Conservative candidate for New York's 26th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Timothy M. Kennedy.
According to Ballotpedia, citing information Hannon submitted through its candidate survey, Hannon's career experience includes working as a technology professional.
According to the campaign website, Hannon grew up working in a father's construction business and is a parent.
